Quash The Charge Sheet And Entire Proceedings In
C.C.No.122/2020 A/O Crime.No.148/2019 For The
Offences Punishable Under Sections 498(A), 323 R/W 34
Of Ipc On The File Of The Honble Vii Additional Senior
Civil Judge And Jmfc, Mysore.
 This Petition, Coming On For Reporting
Settlement, This Day, The Court Made The Following:
 Order

This petition is filed by the petitioners/accused nos.1 and 2 under Section 482 of Cr.P.C., for quashing criminal proceedings in C.C.No122/2020 arising out of Crime No.148/2019 registered by the Women Police Station, Mysuru, City for the offences punishable under Sections 498A & 323 R/w 34 of IPC, pending on the file of VII Addl. Senior Civil Judge & JMFC, Mysuru.

entities.text: VII Addl. Senior Civil Judge & JMFC, Mysuru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. During pendency of the petition, both the parties have appeared before the Court along with their counsels and filed compromise application along with affidavit on NC: 2024:KHC:2284 I.A.No.1/2024 under Section 320 R/w Section 482 of Cr.P.C., seeking permission of this Court to compound the offence and submits that they have settled their dispute between them amicably.
3. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioners submits that, the parties have dissolved the dispute and divorce has been granted by the Family Court, Mysuru.
4. Learned counsel appearing for respondent no.2 submits that he has no objection to allow the petition.

5. Considering the above and in view of the judgment of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of GIAN SINGH V. STATE OF PUNJAB - (2012) 10 SCC 303, wherein it has been held that in cases where the parties have settled the dispute between them in respect of a matrimonial case, the court can quash the proceedings.
6.

The parties are permitted to compound the offence.
